name: Import skins and animations from glTF
body: `GltfLoader` reads meshes only. Read skins (joints, inverse bind matrices, JOINTS_0 and WEIGHTS_0) and animation channels (translation, rotation, scale; linear and step) into the new Skeleton and Clip types, so a character authored in Blender can replace the mannequin. Not started: the first step builds the runtime the importer feeds.
